name: Global Diversity Training
description:
Working in international teams is part of everyday life in many study and work contexts. It offers great opportunities but also brings challenges such as misunderstandings or conflicts. 
This seminar prepares students to collaborate effectively in diverse teams and to reflect on how cultural backgrounds influence team processes. Using science-based models, practical exercises, and reflection, participants explore how diversity shapes teamwork and how to handle intercultural situations constructively. 
  
We will address, among other things: 
•	Awareness of our own cultural background and its impact on collaboration 
•	Strategies to deal with culture shock and intercultural challenges 
•	Roles and tasks of team leaders in diverse settings 
•	Practical case studies from professional and daily life
